tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(daemon): declare least-privilege tools on every example recipe

Removes main.go's {"text": "see email body"} placeholder arg -- the
summarize command takes no args now that the real body arrives through
the mission context (previous commit). Declares tools: [] on summarize,
reply, and docs-ask: none of the three need a built-in tool, only what
their mcp_servers already grant, and empty is now enforced as "none",
not the fixed shell every worker used to get regardless of its recipe.
sysreport is unchanged -- it's a cli-runner recipe and tools does not
apply to it.

Updates the recipe prompts that told the worker to "submit ... as the
mission result": that instruction needed Bash/Write neither recipe has
anymore, and the pipeline never reads a submitted mission result on
this path anyway -- it captures the worker's final response text
directly. Replaced with wording that matches what actually happens.

Expands examples/recipes/README.md to cover summarize.yaml and
reply.yaml (previously undocumented) and adds a section on the tools:
field's least-privilege convention.

Closes beadle-ivtd.
EOF
)"
